messages:
maria (AE): FYI Silverline wants a 2-week POC. They plan to bring a custom Llama-70B variant and require private deployment (VPC/on‑prem), KMS integration, and an SLA. Can we outline compatibility and a rough cost/time estimate? :eyes:
jake (Sales-Eng): Asked a few clarifying q's in the call: target latency p95 < 300ms for 1-2k qps burst, and they want token-based billing for hosted fallback. On‑prem is priority though.
nikhil (ML Eng): Quick checks: does their variant use standard RoPE/ALiBi? Any fused attention kernels? We'll need model artifacts (hf or ggml), tokenizer files, and an exemplar config. Memory wise, Llama-70B full FP16 needs ~140GB; with q4_0/q8_0 we can get to ~40-60GB per shard.
anya (Security): Also they attached a security questionnaire — Data residency: EU-only production, US staging ok. They want KMS + HSM-backed key control, audit logs retention 1y, and SCIM provisioning. I'll go through the questionnaire but need to know the deployment footprint. :lock:
jake (Sales-Eng): For the POC we can propose 4 GPU nodes (A100s or H100s) with shard-aware adapter, and a hosted fallback to smaller quantized variant if on‑prem capacity is saturated. Will rough cost this out.
maria (AE): Can we give them a preflight checklist to speed the POC? They asked for an "adapter" path so they don't re-train.
nikhil (ML Eng): Draft adapter checklist: 1) Provide model weights + tokenizer (archive) 2) Provide example prompts (seq len distribution) 3) Confirm attention type + kv-cache layout 4) Desired quantization (q4_0 / q8_0) 5) Any custom ops. Example config we can accept: ```model_id: silverline-70b-v2
format: hf/pt
tokenizer: tokenizer.json
quant: q4_0
deployment_mode: private
shards: auto
preferred_gpus: [A100,H100]
```
anya (Security): On KMS: we can support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (AWS KMS + external HSM option). Need to confirm whether their legal requires key escrow. Send questionnaire answers back and highlight the KMS flow for them.
maria (AE): I'll attach the questionnaire responses once you confirm KMS + audit retention. Also need example SLA language for POC -> prod transition.
jake (Sales-Eng): For compatibility: if their model uses custom fused kernels we'll either run in Triton with a custom plugin or fall back to a generic slow path. Need them to flag any custom CUDA ops now.
nikhil (ML Eng): Performance knobs for POC: enable KV caching on prefix-heavy workloads, batch size 8 for latency target, adaptive batching for bursts. If they want throughput >2k qps we should recommend Dedicated reserved capacity.
maria (AE): Action items: 1) Nikhil to validate model artifacts once Silverline uploads 2) Anya to mark high-risk items in sec questionnaire 3) Jake to send preliminary POC cost estimate and node sizing 4) I'll coordinate dates with customer.
nikhil (ML Eng): Can someone create a short upload guide for them (S3 presigned + checksum) and include exact file layout we expect? I can use that to run a dry compatibility test.
jake (Sales-Eng): I'll draft the POC quote with two paths: (A) 4-node on‑prem (H100) with dedicated networking + KMS, (B) Hybrid: private for prod, hosted fallback for spikes. Put estimated cost bands and an opt-in for quantization support.
maria (AE): Great. @anya, @nikhil — ping me when you have the checklist and security flags. I'll loop in legal for the SLA. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: staging-cluster requested: silverline-poc-staging scheduled for 1746010800Z on 4xA100-80GB. Logs will appear in /clusters/silverline-poc.
anya (Security): Received. I'll start the questionnaire pass today and post redlines.
nikhil (ML Eng): I'll mock a compatibility run with a small 1GB subset once they upload. Will report perf numbers in this thread.
maria (AE): Thanks team — I'll update Silverline with the ask list and a target kickoff next week.
__notes: Thread follows agents.md: single continuous string of messages, short Slack-style replies, includes participants and timestamps as strings.
